name: SARS-CoV-2 Mpro 342 Holo-structures Benchmark
description: A benchmark collection of 342 crystallographic holo-structures of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease used to evaluate computational methods (e.g., docking, refinement, scoring).
evaluation_method: Pose accuracy (RMSD to crystal pose), success rate at RMSD thresholds (e.g., <2.0 Å), enrichment/AUC for virtual screening, and correlation metrics (Pearson/Spearman) for scoring
general_score_metric: RMSD-based pose success rate (e.g., % of predictions with RMSD < 2 Å) and scoring correlations (Spearman/Pearson)
typical_sota_score: Pose success (RMSD < 2 Å): typically ~20–60% depending on method; scoring correlations often modest (Spearman/Pearson ~0.2–0.6)
reputation: A focused, domain-specific benchmarking collection used in structure-based drug design and docking method evaluation; recognized within computational structural biology communities for SARS-CoV-2 Mpro benchmarking.
notes: Small, specialized non-LLM dataset (342 holo structures); results sensitive to docking protocol, receptor flexibility, protonation, and crystal artifacts; limitation for generalizability beyond Mpro.
